baseline.scope: Counters/logging only; no change to pre-cache daemon behavior. Built with Rust 1.94.0 and locked dependencies.

metric_scope.requests: Read RPC attempts; one streamed ListEvents call counts once. Per-poll daemon counters include concurrent fleet producers.
metric_scope.bytes: Encoded protobuf response payloads; excludes request bytes, headers, transport framing/compression and top-level transport error-status payloads. Per-item batch errors are included.
metric_scope.measurement: Healthy idle polls after initial validation/cursor migration; no pending writes. Slow scans, due work and failures cost additional reads.
metric_scope.capacity_limit: No 1,000-device load test, production provider capacity, public endpoint allowance or monetary bill is established.

measurements.fixture: OTA simulator; known group; no fleet producer or budget
assertions: No successful idle poll performs validation/event reads
Revocation, rotation, stale UpgradeCap, simulated chain reset and missing DeviceCap force fail-closed revalidation within the next poll

measurements.fixture: Fleet simulator; health and archives enabled, not due
assertions: No health/archive validation reads while asleep
A watched core-package upgrade blocks due background writes even if the cap remains valid

measurements.fixture: Actual disposable localnet; metrics-only baseline then current daemon on the same fresh fixture
measurements.network: Docker --network none; private writable Move-cache copy; Sui 1.81.1 compiler/node; no host ports/wallets
assertions: Warm cache detects actual on-chain revocation and rotation
Compatible package upgrade invalidates stale manifest before more apply
Terminating/replacing the owned node with fresh genesis invalidates the warm cache and stops apply
